history.summary: UNVERIFIED IDENTITY: the only web sources found for a Durga Mandir in Serchhip are hinduvism.com (a listicle saying it is dedicated to Goddess Durga, prominent for Navratri, and was built by the local Hindu community) and inheritage.foundation (AI-generated page giving the address Mission Veng, Serchhip 796181 and making dubious claims of Kachari Kingdom patronage, Bengal Renaissance period, and ASI protection, none of which are corroborated). No founding date, builders' names, or opening hours could be verified. Treat all details as UNVERIFIED.

name: Durga Mandir
town_description: Serchhip is a town in central Mizoram and the headquarters of Serchhip district, about 90 km south of the state capital Aizawl. It is one of Mizoram's older towns and hosts the annual Serchhip paragliding festival. Mizoram is a Christian-majority state, so Hindu temples here are few and serve small local communities.

travel.road: NH-54A connects Serchhip to Aizawl (~90 km); buses and shared taxis run regularly (verify)

visitor_information.best_time: October to March (pleasant weather); Navratri for Durga celebrations (verify)
